statement: PartitionService is assembled by constructor injection instead of prototype copying: the 13 create*Methods bags across the 41 partition-service*.js files become explicit-context modules or constructor-held collaborators as docs/development/code-style.md already prescribes for new extractions, the 12 Object.getOwnPropertyNames(X.prototype) copy loops are deleted, the process-local admission stores (RETIREMENTS_DEFERRED in partition-service-raft-membership-administration.js, ADMISSIONS_IN_FLIGHT and ADMISSIONS_DEFERRED in raft-rs-group-membership-admission.js) become named fields of the owner that re-drives them, and no typeof feature check remains in the pilot owner files; behaviour is unchanged.

constraints.statement: No admission, promotion, retirement or re-drive decision changes. Existing partition witnesses pass with construction-only edits.

Moving a store into its owner changes where it lives, not when it is written or re-driven. The formation ADD continuation owner across a leader change is the formation work's repair and is not absorbed here (R17).
No new *-methods.js fragment, prototype copy or inheritance level is introduced to finish the migration.
Starts after readiness-service-constructor-injection lands, since the pilot-owner row counts both owners.
The src/ changes land only behind an approving verification newer than the last attempt.
